args.body:
- Ironbark Tooling's newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026" covers the state of warehouse automation this year.
- Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Warehouse automation in 2026 (3-bullet summary)
